summary.text: Jill Ward is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 105 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jill Ward graduated from Wichita State University, and her career experience includes working as a sales consultant.

Ward won the Republican primary for Kansas House District 105 on August 6, 2024, defeating David Hickman, and then won the November 5, 2024 general election against John Burke; she took office on January 13, 2025.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development Committee, the House Federal and State Affairs Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.

In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2024, Ward described herself as a lifelong Wichita resident born and raised in the 105th district, working as an account executive and co-owning a small business with her husband.

In the same survey she listed her campaign priorities as reducing the property tax burden on homeowners, eliminating wasteful spending to deliver a balanced budget, and graduating students who are college and career-ready.
She also said she worked with the legislature to pass a law after her son was killed in a hit-and-run accident.
